newsitem.title: USA: KANSAS FED CATTLE TRADE BRISK AT $65, UP $1- USDA.
newsitem.headline: KANSAS FED CATTLE TRADE BRISK AT $65, UP $1- USDA.

text.p: Confirmed - 20,200 head. Trade was active, with slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt higher, USDA said. Inquiry was good and demand fairly good. Sales confirmed on 9,000 slaughter steers and 11,200 slaughter heifers Wednesday.
For the week to date 55,800 head confirmed including 29,900 head previously contracted or formulated cattle.

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 65.00, pen 1375 lbs 64.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1125 lbs 65.00, few mixed Commercial to Choice 1075-1125 lb heifers and heiferettes 62.50-63.00.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
